sources.excerpt: Particle Drive — Citadel Electronics 0 Skip to Content ABOUT PRODUCTS MEDIA CONTACT Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT PRODUCTS MEDIA CONTACT Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT PRODUCTS MEDIA CONTACT Products › Particle Drive Image 1 of 6 Image 2 of 6 Image 3 of 6 Image 4 of 6 Image 5 of 6 Image 6 of 6 Particle Drive €0.00 Particle Drive is an overdrive pedal designed to replicate the essence of a modern British high gain amplifier. The effective gain staging allows the pedal to deliver mild overdrives as well as full blown high gain tones. It combines distortion with the adaptive noise gate technology found on our Dynazero pedal. Controls LEVEL controls the output volume of the pedal. GATE sets the threshold at which the noise gate activates, allowing only signals above this level to pass through while muting or reducing those below. The gate detector is placed before the distortion circuit for precise signal control. TONE shapes the high-frequency response after the distortion circuit, allowing you to fine-tune the brightness or darkness of the overall tone. DRIVE adjusts the amount of distortion. BODY selects from three distinct voicings, each offering a unique midrange character. These tonal differences are particularly noticeable when Particle Drive is paired with a clean amplifier. Together with the Tone control, the Body switch provides a powerful frequency-shaping tool, allowing you to fine-tune the distortion’s tone and adapt its response to complement your amplifier’s characteristics. TRUE BYPASS WITH INITIAL STATE SWITCH lets you set the pedal’s startup state using the side switch, determining whether it powers up in bypass or engaged mode. Specifications Input impedance: 1 MΩ Output impedance: 100 Ω Power supply (not included): Voltage: +9 VDC Polarity: Center negative Current draw: 100 mA Dimensions: Length:114 mm Width: 62 mm Height: 58 mm Weight: 250g Manual Particle Drive (English / Deutsch / Español) Product features, specifications, and appearance are subject to change without notice.
